name: Saiyan Dynamic Mastery
text:
(You may begin the game on Level 2.)
[Continuous]: You need 6 anger to advance a personality level. Your Styled attacks without "anger" printed in the text-box gain "Raise your anger 1."
note: portrait FanZ Mastery layout; title and number confirmed from a crop of the original

name: Saiyan Rampaging Mastery
text:
[Continuous]: You need 1 less anger to advance a personality level (to a minimum of 4). Your Styled attacks gain "HIT: You may raise your anger 1."
POWER: Discard a Styled card with Endurance from your hand to perform a non-Styled physical attack dealing 1 + X stages. X = the amount of Endurance on the discarded card.
note: portrait FanZ Mastery layout; title and number confirmed from a crop of the original

name: Black Mischievous Drill
text:
(Limit 1 per deck.)
[Continuous]: Whenever your opponent plays a Setup or Drill, you may destroy the top 4 cards of your Life Deck. If you do, banish that Setup or Drill.
note: landscape FanZ Drill layout; FanZ reprint of S01 R123 (same text)

name: Black Targeting Drill
text: [Continuous]: Whenever your opponent discards a card from their hand from one of your effects, the cards are chosen at random. Your opponent's physical attacks cost +1 stage to perform.
note: landscape FanZ Drill layout; FanZ reprint of S01 S37 with 'his hand' changed to 'their hand'

name: Black Chin Kick
text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
Allies lose all effects until the end of combat. Allies cannot make actions nor have damage redirected to them this combat.
DAMAGE: AT + 3 stages.
HIT: Raise your anger X. X = your current anger level.

text:

name: Unleashed
text:

If your opponent cannot win by MPPV, destroy any number of cards attached to your MP. Lower your opponent's MP level equal to the number of cards destroyed this way.
(Banish after use.)
